seedBackup.warning3: Never publish this backup online or share it with anyone

seedBackup.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. You will need this password and the backup file to recover your account.
seedBackup.rawKeyWarning: Your raw private key gives full control of your account. Anyone with this string can publish as you.
